description: This file contains the server-side logic for the login page of an online examination system. It handles user authentication for students and teachers/admins, including database validation for students and hardcoded check for admin login.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Represents the login page with server-side event handlers for user authentication in the online exam system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently does nothing on load.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the event when the signup button is clicked, transfers the user to the signup page.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles login button click, authenticates user either against the database (for students) or via hardcoded admin credentials, then redirects accordingly.
